summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests CTX-712, a drug taken by mouth, in adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML) or higher risk myelodysplastic syndromes (HR-MDS). Patients take 20 mg tablets once or twice a week, depending on their dose level, during each 28-day cycle, and how long treatment continues is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics in the dose-finding part, and the later Phase 2 part will evaluate therapeutic activity.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa CTX-712, un medicamento que se toma por vía oral, en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda (LMA) recidivante o refractaria, o con síndromes mielodisplásicos (SMD) de mayor riesgo. Los pacientes toman tabletas de 20 mg una o dos veces por semana, según su nivel de dosis, durante cada ciclo de 28 días, y no se indica por cuánto tiempo continúa el tratamiento. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética y la farmacodinamia en la parte de búsqueda de dosis, y la siguiente parte de fase 2 evaluará la actividad terapéutica.
who_for: Diagnosis of AML, higher risk MDS, or MDS/MPN with high marrow blast count, including CMML.
Prior treatment with 1 to 4 lines of therapy (1 to 3 in expansion cohorts).
Adequate organ function by lab values, and ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Women who can have children must have a negative pregnancy test and use effective contraception; men with such partners must use contraception or abstain.
not_for: Active leukemia in the central nervous system.
